target_customer: Companies building voice agents, such as healthcare and enterprise voice AI teams (Luma Health, Netomi, Maven AGI named)
problem: Voice agents fail in unpredictable ways and teams test them by phoning them by hand; they need automated pre-launch testing and production monitoring.
business_model: SaaS subscription, usage based, enterprise plans
product_category: QA, testing and monitoring for AI voice agents

founders.name: Sumanyu Sharma
founders.background_notes: Senior staff data scientist at Tesla; ran trust and safety infrastructure at Citizen.

founders.name: Marius Buleandra
founders.background_notes: Co-founder per launch post and company blog; ran data infrastructure at Anduril.

technical_complexity.rationale: Simulating thousands of voice calls with LLM personas, audio analysis and scoring, with latency and realism challenges; standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Test suites and monitoring data create some lock-in, but several YC peers sold the same wedge and the technique is replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Voice platforms such as Vapi and Retell added their own testing features by 2025 per comparison articles; no acquisition of Hamming found.

market_need_then: Voice agents were exploding in 2024 and Sharma's Citizen and Tesla experience showed testing AI at scale mattered. Customers reported ad hoc manual call testing.

branding.domain_note: hamming.ai, exact name on .ai; no purchase story found

identity.visual_style: Product suite with color themed names (RedSwarm, GreenLoop, BlueTrace)
identity.voice_and_tone: Trust and security oriented, tagline Voice agents you can trust

branding.brand_signature: Color themed product names RedSwarm, GreenLoop, BlueTrace
branding.community_and_virality: Company claims a #1 ranking in a SOTA2 healthcare evaluation badge and publishes security research; no independent press on the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name matches Hamming distance and codes, a plausible but unsourced nod, and shares the surname of a famous computer scientist; no brand-driven growth evidence.

outcome_analysis: Hamming is active, raised a 3.8M seed in December 2024 led by Mischief and now claims SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance, offices in four cities and customers like Luma Health and Netomi. Strength comes from the voice AI wave and the founders' scale testing background. Competition from Cekura, Coval and platform vendors is the main risk. No Series A found.
notes: Seed confirmed by company blog plus Axios and Pulse2. Aggregators list 4.3M or 5M totals, unverified. Name origin not found; the Richard Hamming link is unsourced. Competition left empty: searches returned only 2026 comparison pages (Cekura formerly Vocera, Coval, Roark), none dated near the Summer 2024 batch. Founded year not stated in sources opened. The 2026 site tagline reads security layer for voice and chat agents, which may signal a repositioning; no source states a pivot.
